title: Unsupported components need lifecycle decisions and replacement evidence
remediation: Component maintainers and the deployment asset owner reconcile installed versions against dated supplier support commitments. For a sampled unsupported component, retain a verified replacement or an approved alternative support arrangement, its authority, residual risk and review date. Link the deployed inventory, updated support evidence and verification results.

milestones.title: Collect current inventory and supplier support dates, and a sampled replacement verification or signed alternative support decision
